quote: These have the appearance of imperatives, but are clearly not—in the first example, an imperative would contain yourself, not you.

quote: Response forms are inserts used as brief and routinized responses to a previous remark by a different speaker.

The spellings yep and nope represent variants of yeah and no with a stop consonant—in effect, an abrupt lip closure—at the end. They sound more abrupt aud peremptory than the more common variants with a final vowel.
Uh huh and mhm also have negative counterparts normally spelt huh uh and unh unh. Both are often spoken with a rising tone.
note: L854–855. "Both" refers to the negative pair, not to MMHM.
